videos.title: My Tessy, Dying a Hero — Namreras 🕯️ | ESO Wood Elf
videos.description:
She waited for the news of her husband for days. When it finally comes, it's the version he asked for. 🕯️

Healer Namreras has known Tesamoril all these years — and he still managed to surprise her. After his spirit asked you to tell her he died a hero, you carried the message to the Sunport Rampart Camp. This is what it costs to deliver it.

Quest: A Cold Grave
Character: Healer Namreras
Race: Wood Elf
Location: Sunport Rampart Camp, Solstice

Subscribe for daily Tamriel wisdom and full NPC encounters.

#ElderScrollsOnline #ESO #ESOShorts #WoodElf #Solstice #SeasonTwo #Tamriel
